Sub List #5: Domain '62 to 48' â€” REVERSED domain (end < start) selects items in reverse order. Each Sub List â†’ Quad Panels output â†’ Custom Preview with different visualization. category: Intermediate - Surface Creation and List Operations
solution_principle: Sub List extracts a contiguous range of items from a list using a Domain (start, end). Different domains select different panel subsets â€” useful for region-specific operations. Reversed domains (end < start) return items in reverse order. Sub List is more efficient than multiple List Item calls for extracting ranges.
